article.story: CONWAY, S.C. -- — Christian Harmon scored 16 points as Arkansas State beat Coastal Carolina 70-66 on Wednesday night. Harmon added five rebounds and three steals for the Red Wolves (14-10, 6-6 Sun Belt Conference). Joey Chammaa scored 13 points, going 3 of 8 from the floor, including 2 for 6 from 3-point range, and 5 for 8 from the line. Kyle Hayman had 12 points on four 3-pointers. The Chanticleers (14-11, 7-6) were led by Josh Beadle, who finished with 16 points. AJ Dancier added 12 points for Coastal Carolina. Reggie Hill finished with eight points, seven rebounds and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
